events.title: Let's talk! Plus: Pretty Soon joins Neuron Activation
events.summary: Hey everyone! I’ve got some cool news to share.Neuron Activation is now being published by Pretty Soon, a publisher focused on solo developers (like me!) and small teams. It felt like a really good fit from the start. Everyone there is excited about the project, and it feels great to be working with caring and creative people.If you have the time, I’d love for you to take part in a casual 1:1 interview about the game.These aren’t formal feedback sessions or bug reports. events.title: Neuron Activation on InterfaceX26
events.summary: I'm excited to share that Neuron Activation will be part of InterfaceX26! 🎉InterfaceX is a special event celebrating “Fake OS” games, those experiences where you explore systems or OSs, uncover stories through digital interfaces, and explore these virtual environments. It’s amazing to see so many talented people coming together to highlight this unique genre.The event runs from April 27 to May 4 on Steam, featuring tons of interesting and creative games, and a live showcase on May 2.
